data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 1610, merged to main as 3701dcbe3b04fbfda8f7e1d9736fb4506e9d1ada (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). Gerrit rebased server-side on submit, so the merged SHA differs from the pushed 880e6bd.

All six ACs verified against the merged tree:
- AC1 per-type open bound, AC2 pre-enqueue CLAIM skip, AC3 corrupt-newest fallback, AC4 filename/body timestamp coupling — tests/unit/test_enrich_queue.py + tests/unit/test_store.py, 35 passed.
- AC5 unchanged claim/drain semantics — tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py + tests/integration/test_concurrency_regression.py, 50 passed.
- AC6 no deletion or rename — the merged diff introduces no os.unlink/os.remove/os.rename/shutil.rmtree.

Scope reminder for whoever picks up the follow-on: this fixed the ASYMPTOTE (the opens term), not today's constant. listdir still dominates, and the drain gate still logs ~600-1000 ms against its 20 ms budget on this tracker. The remaining lever is a store-level index or a cheaper gate — separate work, tracked under the parent design 475e-9b99-9085-4b2d.
